{{Top|leg}}
The '''technology tram''' was a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] system used onboard [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruisers]] for [[transportation]]. It was arranged in a network and connected several areas, for example, the crew deck with the cargo deck.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|Mandalorian Raiders}}</ref>

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''
